nodes.summary: Opencode command for understanding a project and creating/updating AGENTS.md as the AI agent operational guide. Covers 20 sections: project discovery, technology stack detection, architecture analysis, coding conventions, frontend/backend/database conventions, core concept detection, development workflow (SDD), conflict detection, and AGENTS.md structure template.
nodes.description: Comprehensive project understanding command that inspects repository structure, detects technology stack, discovers architecture, identifies coding conventions, analyzes permanent knowledge docs, and produces/maintains AGENTS.md as the authoritative project guide for AI coding agents.

nodes.summary: Opencode command for creating or updating permanent project knowledge documents (PRD, architecture, database, design-system) by delegating to the permanent-knowledge skill.
nodes.description: Thin command wrapper that loads the permanent-knowledge skill to inspect the repository, understand the project, identify the Core Concept, and create/update docs/PRD.md, docs/architecture.md, docs/database.md, and docs/design-system.md.

nodes.summary: Opencode command for generating or updating SDD (Spec-Driven Development) task specifications. Produces complete mini-specifications with requirements, domain model, API design, UI/UX spec, acceptance criteria, implementation checklist, and verification steps.
nodes.description: Generates structured SDD task specifications covering: project knowledge reading, existing task analysis, task identity (NN-kebab-case), scope determination, mini-specification generation (with Domain, Data Model, API, UI/UX, Acceptance Criteria, Implementation, Verification sections), cross-document consistency checks, and final response reporting.

nodes.name: SDD Workflow
nodes.description: Spec-Driven Development workflow: Permanent Knowledge → Task → Plan → Implement → Verify → Review. This is the core development methodology defined by these opencode commands.

nodes.name: Permanent Knowledge
nodes.description: Project-level documentation suite: docs/PRD.md, docs/architecture.md, docs/database.md, docs/design-system.md. These are authoritative references maintained by the knowledge command and consumed by init-project and task commands.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.description: The primary output of init-project.md — a comprehensive operational guide for AI coding agents describing project overview, core concept, tech stack, architecture, conventions, coding guidelines, verification commands, and development workflow.

edges.description: init-project.md defines the SDD workflow stages (Permanent Knowledge → Task → Plan → Implement → Verify → Review) in section 13
init-project.md instructs agents to inspect docs/PRD.md, docs/architecture.md, docs/database.md, docs/design-system.md as project knowledge
init-project.md's primary output is creating or updating AGENTS.md
init-project.md references the SDD workflow where /knowledge is a prior step for establishing permanent knowledge
init-project.md's final response recommends /task as the next step after understanding the project
knowledge.md delegates to the permanent-knowledge skill to create/update PRD, architecture, database, and design-system docs
knowledge.md is the first step in the SDD workflow (Permanent Knowledge phase)
task.md requires reading AGENTS.md, docs/PRD.md, docs/architecture.md, docs/database.md, docs/design-system.md before generating task specifications
task.md is the second step in the SDD workflow (Task phase), generating structured task specifications
task.md reads AGENTS.md as the first step of project knowledge
